Classic Photoshop pixel tools and layer commands: dodge/burn/sponge/smudge, background and magic eraser, history brush, quick mask, merge down/visible/flatten/stamp, an explicit rasterize command, layer tags/colour labels/layer comps, focus stacking and sky replacement.

Effect registration contract: no StudioEffectDescriptor, gpu_requirement, EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE result, EFFECT_PARAM_CONTRACT validation, StudioValidationDescriptor check, source value-encoding import, or repeat-last-effect command.

Filter catalogue breadth: no Effect Gallery (artistic, brush strokes, sketch, texture), most pixelate/stylize/render filters (clouds, lighting, lens flare), live pathfinder and SVG-filter vector effects, vanishing point and other interactive workspaces, the guided audio (Essential Sound) surface and the loudness-standard enumeration.

Kernel-side integration (outside the assets repo): handshake_core::studio binding, SurrealDB studio_* tables, sandbox and PromotionGate path, auto-accept host policy, Palmistry and wait-free render diagnostics, pre-account render gate; AI adapter lanes stay parked per STU-ARC-019.
notes: Method: spec clause read at its definition line in master-spec-v02.229 14-studio-creative-suite.md; code read from a git archive of origin/codex/handshake-studio-assets 87f331f9 (crates/*.rs, *.wgsl, Cargo.toml); spec-ID citations compared between 87f331f9 and the last validated round tip c4d06841 (R59). No cargo, builds or tests were run.

VALIDATED = clause implemented in code present at c4d06841 and a covering lane is PASS_V* in ledger.json; BUILT_NOT_VALIDATED = implementing code added after R59 by a READY_FOR_VALIDATION lane; PARTIAL also covers typed refusals (for example brush tip kinds, on-device ML selection).

Only 11 of these IDs gained their first code citation after R59 (ARC-024, ARC-032, FX-007, FX-012, FX-016, FX-020, FX-101, FX-128, RAS-029, RAS-042, RAS-145); they come from READY_FOR_VALIDATION lanes SMB-VK-HOST-1, SMB-AI-LIVE-EFFECTS-1, SMB-PIGMENT-FILTER-KERNELS-1, SMB-PLACE-ASSET-1, SMB-DOC-EXPORT-1, SMB-DOC-NEW-1, SMB-COMMAND-SURFACE-1.

ui = window only where a harness-view egui tool or panel drives the feature (layers, edit/brush, fill tools, select/liquify, info, proof, swatches, mixer/waveform, controls). Adjustments, layer styles, filters, retouch, channels, colour-mode conversion and HDR merge have engine code but no window control at the tip; the native Vulkan host shows no raster controls.

No LOCAL rows: the in-progress lanes touching these areas (SMB-SCORE-EFFECTS-6, SMB-R60-FOLLOWUPS-1) do not implement any of these clauses beyond what is already on origin; FX-138 is not covered by SMB-SCORE-EFFECTS-6.
Index section fields for retained RAS anchors point at the disposition table; rows use the heading above the clause definition instead. RAS-140 is unissued.
